title: New Jersey Air Victory Museum
specs: Displays include historic military aircraft such as F-4A Phantom II, A-4C Skyhawk, A-7B Corsair II, E-2B Hawkeye
Aircraft on display have detailed historical backgrounds and service records
Museum preserves priceless artifacts from aviation history for future generations

blurb: The museum displays a variety of historic military aircraft including the F-4A Phantom II, A-4C Skyhawk, A-7B Corsair II, E-2B Hawkeye, and others. It also features engines and ordnance used in aviation history. The museum is maintained largely by volunteers and preserves aviation history for public education.
